description: This PHP class 'ImpactDataItem' models the relationship between impact data and impact items within the Goteo project. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, validating, and deleting impact data items, and interacts with the database table 'impact_data_item'.

classes.name: ImpactDataItem
classes.description: A model class representing an item of impact data, linking ImpactData and ImpactItem entities, with methods for CRUD operations and validation.

methods.name: setImpactData
methods.description: Sets the ImpactData object and returns the ImpactDataItem instance.

methods.name: setImpactItem
methods.description: Sets the ImpactItem object and returns the ImpactDataItem instance.

methods.name: getListByImpactData
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ImpactDataItem objects associated with a given ImpactData.

methods.name: getByImpactItem
methods.description: Retrieves an ImpactDataItem object associated with a specific ImpactItem.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the ImpactDataItem to the database, performing insert or update.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the ImpactDataItem fields, populating errors if invalid.

methods.name: dbDelete
methods.description: Deletes ImpactDataItem records from the database based on specified conditions.
